descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 10 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (3 cartridges), velocity error 3.0 % rms. Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, double-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data. Test barrels from the RWS reloading book (600 mm, 650 mm for some magnums); only the maximum load has a velocity (v3, 3 m from the muzzle). Fewer data or a poorer fit than most other records (see the quality Qlty): use with more caution.
